Roof Plumbing & Re-Roofing in Mordialloc

Sandhurst Roofing is a family owned roofing business with more than 30 years of experience looking after homes right across Mordialloc. From re-roofs in COLORBOND® steel and roof plumbing to guttering and tile to tin conversions, we back every job with honest advice and quality workmanship.

Mordialloc sits close to the water, so we know what salt air and wind do to metal roofs, flashings and gutters, and we recommend materials that stand up to it. Call Steve on 0448 812 800 for a free, no-obligation quote.

Get a Free Quote!

Roofs in Mordialloc: What We Commonly See

Mordialloc is a bayside suburb wrapped around its creek and foreshore, with a mix of older beach cottages, period homes and post-war brick. Many carry original roofs, or early metal roofs, that have lost their finish and gone rusty after years near the water.

That close-to-the-bay position means salt air corrodes metal roofs, fixings, valleys and gutters faster than inland. The problems we are called out for most in Mordialloc are rusted gutters and valleys, lifted and cracked ridge capping, and leaks where flashings have failed.

Re-Roofing & Roof Replacement in Mordialloc

When a roof has reached the end of its life, replacing it is the smarter long-term spend. We re-roof Mordialloc homes in COLORBOND® steel, which is light, strong and well suited to bayside weather, and we use quality fixings, flashings and gutters that stand up to salt air.

If you are thinking about going metal, our tile to tin service is a popular way to lose the weight and the upkeep. If you are unsure whether you need a full re-roof, we will inspect the roof, show you what we find and give you an honest recommendation.

Roof Plumbing & Guttering in Mordialloc

Our registered roof plumbers look after the parts of the roof that take the most punishment near the water: flashings, valleys, ridge capping, box gutters and downpipes. Salt air eats through poorly finished metal quickly, so we trace leaks back to the real source and fix them properly rather than patching the ceiling stain.

Whether you need one section of guttering replaced or a full re-gutter with matching downpipes in COLORBOND® steel, we will quote it clearly and finish it neatly. Small jobs such as gutter repairs are no problem either.

What Affects the Cost of Roofing in Mordialloc

There is no standard price for a roof, because no two roofs are the same. The size and pitch of the roof, the profile and colour of the steel, the amount of guttering, flashings and downpipes, and the access to the site all affect the quote. We inspect the roof, put the price in writing and explain every line.

Our Mordialloc Roofing Process

It starts with a free on-site inspection and a written quote. Once you approve it we strip the existing roof, check and prepare the framing, then install new COLORBOND® steel sheeting, flashings and ridge capping, along with new guttering and downpipes where they are part of the job. Every job finishes with a clean site.

Why Mordialloc Locals Choose Sandhurst Roofing

Mordialloc locals choose Sandhurst Roofing because we turn up when we say we will, do quality work and charge a fair price. We are fully licensed and insured, with registered roof plumbers on the team, and we explain what is happening every step of the way. Have a look at the COLORBOND® colour chart to start choosing your colour.

Mordialloc Roofing FAQs

Does living near the bay affect my roof?

Yes. Salt air corrodes metal roofs, fixings, flashings and gutters faster than it does inland, so coastal homes benefit from quality COLORBOND® materials and regular checks.

How long does a re-roof take?

Most homes are completed in a few days, weather depending. We will give you a realistic timeframe with your quote.

Do you offer free quotes?

Yes, every quote is free and without obligation. Call Steve on 0448 812 800.
